title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Basis for Voluntary Itinerary Changes
content:
A voluntary itinerary change is determined by the fare brand held on the booking. That brand settles whether the travel dates may be changed after ticketing, whether the origin or destination may be changed after ticketing, how many voluntary changes one ticket bears, the change fee charged for each traveller, the fee for a same-day move between flights on the booked routing, the fee to be listed for standby on an earlier flight, whether the difference to the new fare is collected, and what becomes of the unused fare value where the new fare is the cheaper. The desk reads each of these from the schedule of Air Ticket Fare Brands set out below, and from nothing else.

| Fare brand | Change fee for each traveller, USD | Same-day move on the booked routing, USD | Voluntary changes one ticket bears | Origin or destination may be changed | Travel dates may be changed | Difference to the new fare | Unused fare value where the new fare is cheaper | Standby on an earlier flight, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | not permitted | not permitted | collected | forfeited | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | 199.00 | 99.00 | 1 | not permitted | permitted | collected | forfeited | 75.00 |
| Economy Classic | 149.00 | 75.00 | 2 | not permitted | permitted | collected | returned as travel credit | 50.00 |
| Economy Flex | 99.00 | 75.00 | 4 | permitted | permitted | collected | returned as travel credit | 25.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 75.00 | 50.00 | 4 | permitted | permitted | collected | returned as travel credit | 25.00 |
| Business Saver | 50.00 | 25.00 | 6 | permitted | permitted | collected | refunded | 0.00 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 0.00 | 12 | permitted | permitted | collected | refunded | 0.00 |

Bases of judgement.

The two permissions are read together. Under Basic Economy Lite neither the dates nor the origin or destination may be changed, and the ticket bears 0 voluntary changes. Under Economy Saver and Economy Classic the dates may be changed and the origin or destination may not, the one bearing 1 voluntary change and the other 2. Under Economy Flex, Premium Economy Select, Business Saver and Business Flex both the dates and the origin or destination may be changed, the ticket bearing 4, 4, 6 and 12 voluntary changes respectively.

The difference to the new fare is collected under every one of the seven brands, so that line turns on nothing.

Where the new fare is the cheaper, the unused value is forfeited under Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver, returned as travel credit under Economy Classic, Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select, and refunded under Business Saver and Business Flex.

The change fee and the same-day fee are separate lines of the schedule. A same-day move between flights on the booked routing is charged at 99.00 under Economy Saver where a change of that brand is charged at 199.00, and at 75.00 under Economy Flex where a change of that brand is charged at 99.00. Both stand at 0.00 under Basic Economy Lite and under Business Flex. The standby fee runs from 75.00 under Economy Saver down to 50.00, then 25.00 under Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select alike, and 0.00 under Business Saver and Business Flex.
